tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The PCI-E 3.0 x16 Riser Cable (5-Inch / 12.7cm) is a premium-quality PCI Express extension cable designed for high-performance computing, gaming, workstation, and server applications. It supports full PCIe 3.0 x16 bandwidth, ensuring fast and stable data transmission between your motherboard and PCIe expansion devices without compromising performance.


Featuring a compact 5-inch (12.7cm) flexible ribbon design, this PCIe riser cable is ideal for small form factor (SFF) PCs, vertical GPU mounting, custom desktop builds, AI workstations, and open-frame test benches. The high-purity copper conductors and multi-layer EMI shielding help minimize signal loss and electromagnetic interference, providing reliable connectivity for graphics cards, RAID controllers, capture cards, network adapters, and other PCIe devices.


Designed for durability and consistent performance, the PCI-E 3.0 x16 Riser Cable is easy to install with its plug-and-play design and secure connectors. Whether you're building a gaming PC, upgrading a workstation, or optimizing a server, this PCIe extension cable delivers excellent flexibility and dependable performance.


Purchase the PCI-E 3.0 x16 Riser Cable (5-Inch / 12.7cm) at the best price in Bangladesh from OTECH BD. We offer genuine products, competitive pricing, fast nationwide delivery, and reliable customer support.


Key Features

  • Supports full PCI Express 3.0 x16 bandwidth
  • Compact 5-inch (12.7cm) extension cable
  • High-speed, low-latency signal transmission
  • High-purity copper conductors
  • Multi-layer EMI shielding for stable performance
  • Flexible ribbon cable for easy cable management
  • Ideal for vertical GPU installation
  • Compatible with graphics cards, RAID cards, NICs, capture cards, and other PCIe devices
  • Durable connectors with secure fit
  • Plug-and-play installation
